name: Offline
source:
You play as a young cosplayer whose life begins to unravel over seven days: messages, calls, scandals, and routines spiral into anxiety.

[From [url=https://nebul1th.itch.io/offline]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
你將扮演一名年輕的角色扮演愛好者。七天之內，你的生活逐漸失控。訊息、電話、醜聞，連日常瑣事也一併把你捲入越來越深的焦慮。

［摘自[url=https://nebul1th.itch.io/offline]Itch.io[/url]］
